item.subject: science
item.stem: Priya adds a spoonful of sugar to a glass of water and stirs. Her brother Rohan adds a spoonful of sand to another glass of water and stirs. Why do the sugar and the sand affect the water in their glasses differently?

options.A: Sugar particles fit into the spaces between water particles when they dissolve, but sand does not dissolve and its particles settle at the bottom.
options.B: Sugar particles disappear completely in water, but sand particles grow larger after stirring.
options.C: Sugar reacts with water to form a new substance, but sand evaporates when stirred.
options.D: Sugar and sand both dissolve fully, so both glasses behave in exactly the same way.
